violation_type.title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash hands after disposing of gloves during diapering procedures.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver did not wash hands after disposing of gloves during diapering procedures.
A caregiver did not wash their hands after conducting a diaper change in the toddler room.       Note: This was addressed during the inspection and the caregiver washed their hands.
A caregiver in the toddler classroom was observed changing diapers with gloves without washing hands between each diaper change.
A caregiver used the same pair of disposable gloves and did not discard the gloves in between diaper changes in the infant room.
During the inspection I observed that the caregiver did not conduct handwashing  between diaper changes.     Corrected:  The caregiver washed her hands after changing the diaper.
During a walkthrough, a caregiver was observed diapering chidren without changing gloves and handwashing after each child.

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: The Get Set 2 teacher was observed changing multiple children's diapers without changing her gloves in between or washing her hands after removing the gloves. This was corrected at inspection when the teacher was instructed to change her gloves and wash her hands.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver did not wash their hands after conducting a diaper change in the toddler room.       Note: This was addressed during the inspection and the caregiver washed their hands.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: While observing a diaper change in the toddler classroom, caregiver changed gloves  between diaper changes but did not wash her hands between diaper changes.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A teacher did not use gloves while wiping a child's nose.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: It was observed that the caregiver did not wear gloves during the diaper change of a child.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support the caregiver did not wash their hands after the use of disposable gloves.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver changed a diaper and disposed of the gloves and did not wash hands after putting another pair of gloves on to clean changing surface.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver was seen not initially using gloves during diaper changing a child.  The caregiver corrected the action and put gloves on to finish the diapering.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: During the walkthrough, a used glove was observed on a changing table mat.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the glove was removed and the area was sanitized.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: During a walkthrough, a caregiver was observed diapering chidren without changing gloves and handwashing after each child.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient after staff admitted to wearing the same gloves for diapering and feedings without changing or disposing between diapering or feedings.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: One caregiver did not remove gloves and wash their hands between diaper changes.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: During diaper changes in the infant room, a caregiver did not wash her hands after removing the gloves in between diaper changes.
occurrences.facility_name: Yellow Ribbon Scholars Daycare and Learning Center

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver is not washing their hands after removing gloves during diapering.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver was observed to use gloves while changing a diaper. The caregiver then removed the gloves and put on a new pair of gloves without washing their hands in between while assisting children with diapering/restroom break.     This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed and proper handwashing procedures were followed. The director also plans to retrain staff in handwashing.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: Tw caregivers diapering children did not wash hands after taking gloves off and before picking up another child for diapering.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: At time of inspection, a toddler caregiver did not wash hands after conducting diaper change and removed gloves.     At time of inspection, a toddler class did not hand wash children's hands before snack time.
Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver changed seven children without washing her hands between changing her gloves.

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing their gloves in between diapering.    This was corrected when it was addressed with the caregiver.

Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver was observed diapering a child utilizing gloves. Noted: this was correct immediately when the caregiver was instructed to wash their hands.
